method.browser: Playwright Chromium (headless), one fresh page per variant x mode x size x throttle
method.runs: 5 measured runs per configuration after 1 discarded warm-up run; we report median, min and max

timing.js: the operation itself (performance.now around the call)
timing.dom: operation + flushSync(): Svelte has applied every DOM change
timing.frame: operation until requestAnimationFrame + setTimeout(0): the next frame has been produced (includes style/layout; can include waiting for vsync)

method.memory: V8 heap used (CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage) after two forced GCs (CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage), minus the same measure taken after the plain rows were created and before they were assigned

modes.data: no list in the DOM; the page shows a $derived total over every row and the $derived filtered count
modes.window: a keyed each over the first 50 rows of the $derived filtered list (what a virtual list renders at the top)
modes.list: a keyed each over every row (7 cells per row)

ops.assign: list = rows (class: rows.map(r => new RowState(r)); map: new SvelteMap(...))
ops.readAll: sum row.price + row.owner.id over every row, first time after assign
ops.update: change one field (price) of row 5; hybrid: first edit promotes the row to $state
ops.update2: change the same field of the same row again
ops.replace: replace row 7 with a new object
ops.append: add one row at the end
ops.sort: sort by price, descending (deep: in place; raw/hybrid/class: toSorted; map: not applicable)
ops.sortCopy: deep only: the same sort as items = items.toSorted(cmp), on a fresh unsorted list after its own untimed prepare + assign
ops.filter: set the status filter: the $derived filtered list recomputes (about 1 row in 4 matches)
